thread:
Jia Park: Heads-up: support saw a customer with double-looking usage after a streamed request with a toolcall was truncated and resumed. provisional + confirmed both show in console for same RID.

Marco Rivera: paste logs? reconnect or server retry?

Jia Park: client reconnect. snippet:
2026-03-14T12:40:00Z stream:start sid=SID-A route=R1
2026-03-14T12:40:03Z stream:eof toolcall start id=TC-900
2026-03-14T12:40:04Z router:resume sid=SID-B toolcall=TC-900
2026-03-14T12:40:04Z billing:provisional tokens=320 request_id=RID-1200
2026-03-14T12:40:07Z billing:confirmed tokens=540 request_id=RID-1200

Olga Ivanova: looks like dedupe key includes session; session changed so overlap not deduped.

Marco Rivera: quick UX mitigation: hide provisional entries from console when session mismatch on resume. backend fix: prefer request_id when present; otherwise store prefix ranges and subtract overlaps on confirmed.

Jia Park: deploy window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-14 13:00-14:00 UTC. Hotfixes need oncall OK.

Olga Ivanova: I'll add a dashboard alert for provisional+confirmed within 60s with mismatched sessions. Marco can open the console PR. Jia will notify support.

Jia Park: thanks, moving to action items.
summary: Investigation of double-appearing usage in console after stream truncation+resume for a toolcall. Determined dedupe key tied to session caused overlap. Short-term UI hide of provisional on session mismatch, longer-term backend dedupe by request_id or prefix-overlap subtraction. Added dashboard alert and action owners.
